0036: counter = 2; on each working day break if 0 else decrement. 0027: counter = 1; break if 3 else increment. Both start at yesterday and step back one day per iteration. Traced with no holidays: both return today-3; with a non-working day at d-2: both return d-4, i.e. the 3rd working day before today. Same CalendarRule query in both.
